name: ipl-auction
description: IPL auction game: up to 10 human franchises, AI bidders for the rest

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/rules && tsc -p packages/data && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.test:py: cd packages/data/scripts/ratings && python3 -m unittest test_compute_ratings.py test_player_score.py
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @ipl/server" "npm run dev -w @ipl/web"
scripts.ratings:update: npm run data:fetch && npm run score && npm run seed
